question: Yamini Krishnamurthy was honoured with the ___________ in 1977.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy's** dancing career brought her many awards, as well as the **coveted Padma Shree in the year 1968 and the Padma Bhushan in 2001**.
 
• She was also honoured with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1977.
 
• Yamini Krishnamurthy debuted in 1957 in Madras.
 
• She has the honour of being Asthana Nartaki (resident dancer) of th**e Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam.**
 
• She was also known as the** "torch bearer" of the Kuchipudi form of dance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 71-year-old **Kanaka Raju** was awarded the country's fourth civilian honour Padma Shri by the central government for practising, preserving and popularising the Gussadi dance.
 
• **Pt. Venkatesh Kumar** has been chosen for the Kabir Samman award for the year 2017 in recognition of his contribution to the field of Hindustani music.
 
• Hindustani vocalist Pandit Venkatesh Kumar has been chosen for 'Kalidas Samman' given by the Madhya Pradesh Government.
